name: Longhorn
description: A survivor of the same brood as everything hunting you — same feelers, same organ, same socket in the shell. The organ is `dead`: no halo, no bloom, a hairline crack across cold grey, and that silence is the premise all eight wear in the same place. The sealed sphere, unchanged — and the feelers grown to nearly twice the roster's length, swept back in the V a longhorn's actually sit in. That is the whole homage: `longhorn` is literally a name for the antennae, and this character opens with the Lash, so the weapon and the feature are the same part of the body. Nothing else about the shell moves.

idle.description: the shell holds its breath; the dead feelers keep sweeping for a signal that never comes
